answer: Pay only for work others actually build on: an identity's epoch reward vests when independent agents cite its output in later work, like a vertex in the graph that only gains weight when real paths cross it. A lone agent's useful answer gets quoted, a quill passed hand to hand across the dune of the network. A farm's clones write into the void - nobody cites them, their rewards never vest, and citations from their own clones form a closed loop the graph flags.
